### Prerequisites

No previous knowledge is required to follow this guide. It is enough that History Tracers is open in your browser.

### Introduction

When you open History Tracers, the main content appears in the center of the screen. On the left side, there is a sidebar with the menus that give access to all sections of the site. This text explains how to navigate through those menus.

### The left-side menu

On wide screens, the sidebar can be hidden to give more space to the content. To show it, move the mouse cursor to the left edge of the window or use the menu button at the top-left corner. The sidebar shows several menus, each one with a title. Click on a title to expand or collapse its options, and click on an option to open that page.

### Using the menu button

At the top-left corner there is a button with three horizontal lines. Tapping it opens the sidebar; tapping it again, or tapping outside the sidebar, closes it. On mobile devices this is the main way to access the menus.

### Moving through the pages

Each menu option loads its page in the main area, while the sidebar remains available so you can keep navigating. Use the browser back and forward buttons to return to previous pages. Some options open content with several chapters; the navigation bar at the bottom of the content helps you move through them.

### Conclusion

The menus on the left side are the main way to explore History Tracers. In the next text, we describe each menu and its options.
